components.label: 2U rack chassis
components.purpose: Two-rack-unit steel chassis, 483 wide × 89 high × 257 deep mm, 7.0 kg net. Front rack ears plus optional rear ears; a variable-speed fan pulls air rear to front, so the rack needs an open back.
components.limits: The GX7 PowerLight supply is documented by QSC. The internal board, components and heatsink positions are illustrative, not a service drawing.

components.label: Channel 1 gain
components.purpose: Front-panel gain knob with 21 detents for channel 1. In crossover mode channel 1 carries the sub (20–100 Hz).

components.label: Channel 2 gain
components.purpose: Front-panel gain knob with 21 detents for channel 2. In crossover mode channel 2 carries the top box (100 Hz – 20 kHz).

components.label: Signal, clip and power LEDs
components.purpose: Green signal LEDs at −35 dB, red proportional clip LEDs at 0.1% THD, blue power LED. GuardRail reduces gain during heavy clipping rather than shutting down.

components.label: AC power switch
components.purpose: Front-panel AC switch. If the amplifier shuts off after a long burst, switch off and reset the rear breaker after a 30-second cool-down.

components.label: Inputs · XLR and TRS per channel
components.purpose: Balanced 3-pin XLR and 1/4-inch TRS inputs for each channel, wired in parallel so either one feeds through to the other. Pin 2 / tip positive. Input sensitivity 1.2 Vrms, greater than 20 kΩ balanced.

components.label: Inputs · unbalanced phono (RCA)
components.purpose: Unbalanced RCA inputs per channel for nearby sources in the same rack. The manual says not to use the XLR or TRS inputs at the same time.

components.label: Outputs · Speakon combo per channel
components.purpose: Neutrik Speakon combo output per channel that also accepts a 1/4-inch TS plug. Two-wire (1+/1−) Speakon wiring.

components.label: Outputs · binding posts per channel
components.purpose: Two binding-post terminals per channel for bare wire, spade or banana connections, in parallel with the Speakon combo.

components.label: Crossover switch
components.purpose: FULL RANGE: both channels independent, crossover bypassed. CROSSOVER: the signal at channel 1 is split, 20–100 Hz (3rd-order low-pass) to channel 1 for a sub and 100 Hz – 20 kHz (2nd-order high-pass) to channel 2 for the top. Channel 2 inputs are ignored in that mode.

components.label: AC inlet and breaker
components.purpose: IEC mains inlet with a resettable AC breaker beside it. 725 W per channel at 8 Ω draws about 10.1 A at 1/8 power pink noise into 4 Ω at 120 V.

components.label: Rear-to-front fan and vent
components.purpose: Variable-speed fan draws cool air in over the transformer and out through the front. Keep the rear vent clear; install in an open-back rack.

page.practice_notice: Readbacks repeat the QSC spec sheet and manual. The crossover toggle only changes text and the switch position; no gain or signal is simulated.
page.practice_cards:
Simulated QSC GX7 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Powering the S-181 subs
Each modified S-181 is 8 Ω nominal. One per channel in FULL RANGE with an external crossover, or two in parallel per channel at 4 Ω. In CROSSOVER mode channel 1 is the sub feed and channel 2 the top, from one input.
Check the amplifier label first: GX7 gives 725 W at 8 Ω, GX5 500 W.
